Multiplication World Level 7/9 mul_add
Induction on b also work with five rw
Hi, welcome to the Lean Zulip! It's not clear to me from your post what your question is, could you clarify?
I think it's the claim that you can do the level in 5 rewrites via induction on b (see the comment in the level)

This confused me at first as well; but it's not claiming the level can be done in 5 rewrites (which is not true because of the base case), but that only 5 rewrites are necessary for the inductive step specifically (which is true).
(At least, this was my interpretation. Sorry, you probably know more about what was intended than I do!)
